stories.headline: Trump declares 100 percent tariffs on many drones and all aircraft parts
stories.dek:
The United States has already banned future foreign drones from entering the United States unless their companies kiss the ring - as well as routers, robots, and Roombas. Now, President Donald Trump is targeting existing drone imports and parts, too. He's going to try to make them cost a lot more.

stories.headline: There’s a Fatty Liver Epidemic. AI Could Help Get Ahead of It
stories.dek: Over a billion people worldwide have livers with excess fat, which can lead to a host of medical problems. Researchers think AI tools can spot the condition—and help stop it—early enough to save lives.
